data.exact_reserve_text: Syndicate 1110 has provided an LPT of Financial Institutions, Directors & Officers, Professional Indemnity classes to Syndicate 3334 with a Premium of GBP 58.4m received and Technical Provisions of GBP 58.8m (including ULAE) transferred. In August 2020 the Syndicate underwrote into the 2020 YOA a 90% Adverse Development Cover in respect of the casualty reserves for S1458, years of account 2009-2017. The effective date of the cover is from the 1 January 2020 and this transaction has resulted in an increase to Syndicate 1110's gross written premium of GBP 95.2m and an increase to gross and net technical provisions of GBP 82.2m.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Increase to gross and net technical provisions for casualty reserves for years of account 2009-2017.

prior_year_events.event_name: Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) provided to Syndicate 3334
prior_year_events.impact_description: Technical Provisions transferred for Financial Institutions, Directors & Officers, Professional Indemnity classes.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net gross strengthening of GBP 23.4m in prior year reserves. This was primarily driven by the acceptance of an Adverse Development Cover (ADC) for casualty reserves from Syndicate 1458, which increased technical provisions by GBP 82.2m for years 2009-2017. This was partially offset by a release of GBP 58.8m due to an LPT provided to Syndicate 3334 for Financial Institutions, Directors & Officers, and Professional Indemnity classes.

Technical Provisions of GBP 58.8m (including ULAE) transferred

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development table on page 10 shows a significant gross release for prior years, which contradicts the narrative of 'losses' (strengthening) for 2019 and 2017 & prior years of account, and the explicitly quantified gross strengthening from the ADC transaction. The claims development table appears to be heavily impacted by the various LPT and RITC transactions, making it unreliable for calculating prior year development through diagonal comparison. Therefore, the gross prior year development is derived from the explicitly quantified gross impacts of the ADC accepted and LPT provided transactions mentioned in the strategic report.
